quest.title: Antiquity Hunt: Conclusion
quest.description: Daneh from Vahumana seems to be busy with something...
quest.rewards_formatted: Mora x10000, Adventurer's Experience x4, Unknown Item #363348 x1

dialogues.speaker: Daneh
dialogues.text: Oh? Have you found all the replicas?

dialogues.speaker: Daneh
dialogues.text: Marvelous! You really do have a knack for this, don't you?

dialogues.speaker: Daneh
dialogues.text: Well then. This gift is for you. Thanks for taking part in the event organized by our Darshan.

dialogues.speaker: Daneh
dialogues.text: I hope that you've been able to enjoy your taste of archaeology, Traveler.

dialogues.speaker: Daneh
dialogues.text: That said, real-life archaeology tends to be rather dry and labor-intensive work...

dialogues.speaker: Daneh
dialogues.text: But the instant you find that key relic, you will feel as if the struggle was all worth it.

choices.text: And if you fail to dig anything up?

response.speaker: Daneh
response.text: Well, if we don't find anything, then this is, as they say, "a waste of effort."

response.speaker: Daneh
response.text: And to be honest, this is actually what happens more often than not. The instances where we do find something important are quite rare indeed.

response.speaker: Daneh
response.text: But to work in archaeology is to be used to such circumstances and stay optimistic even so. It would only be a matter of time before we collapsed otherwise.

choices.text: I'm quite sure there are situations in which you find nothing.
